features: 500 W RMS boAt Signature Sound: boAt Aavante Bar 3600 Soundbar is your gateway to the realm of matchless audio. 500 W RMS boAt Signature Sound is sure to lend incredibly nuanced listening for heightened immersion into movies, music, and games.

5.1-Channel Surround Sound: 5.1-channel surround sound lets you experience content like never before. Courtesy of the subwoofer and rear speakers, your living room will be transformed into a theatre with thunderous audio.

Multichannel Compatibility: Turn up the sound of your favorite tracks or play games with this soundbar that lets you connect your device easily. Besides Bluetooth v5.3 connectivity, you can also opt for one of the available ports, like optical, HDMI (ARC), AUX, or USB.

EQ Modes: Audio from this soundbar will enthrall you with every form of entertainment. EQ modes, namely Movies, Music, News, and 3D are integrated with preset levels of the sound parameters for a captivating audio joyride.
Bass and Treble Controls: Be one with the sound by personalizing the bass and treble to your hearing. With the effortless equalizer controls, tweak the audio for an enriching feel.
